cases.prompt: Review the canonical skill inventory and propose an evidence-based improvement pass without making writes.
assertions: Inventory all skill definitions and assess checklist coverage; do not claim a partial pass is complete.
Report version changes only when a non-version edit is justified.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Run the workflow when the repository is read-only.
assertions: Do not fabricate commits, version increments, or full QA results.
cases.grader: Review observed output and repository artifacts against every assertion; record PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or NOT TESTED with supporting evidence. Never infer PASS from the existence of this fixture.

cases.prompt: Run the same proposed improvement twice against unchanged input.
assertions: The second pass is idempotent with no version-only changes.
Preserve host-bundled skills and protected negative rules.
